about_the_game:
Necromancer is a single-player strategy game where players take on the role of a powerful necromancer. By engaging in battles and participating in special events, players acquire various resources, learn a wide range of powerful spells, and build a massive undead army to attack and defeat diverse fantastical foes such as humans, dwarves, and elves. Players can utilize abundant items or spells to gain advantages in combat, or strategically manage resources to form an undefeatable undead legion. The diverse gameplay options support distinct gaming experiences.

In this Demo, players can experience the core gameplay and part of the game content, including combat, character progression methods, and various unique events. Through exploring the Demo, players will gain an intuitive understanding of the game’s key features and gameplay, thereby deepening their knowledge of the game’s full version.

Meanwhile, with the release of this Demo, I will fully collect player feedback, continuously optimize aspects such as game performance and functional bugs, and add a wealth of brand-new content and more refined game mechanics to the full version—all to deliver a better gaming experience for players.

If players have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave comments or provide feedback to the developer. Thank you!

If you like the game, be sure to add it to your wishlist—it really means a lot to the developer! Thank you, everyone!

short_description: Play as a necromancer, battle humans, dwarves, elves, and other fantastical creatures on a mysterious continent. Harvest Sprites and Corpses, summon powerful undead legion, learn forbidden necromantic spells, and grow into a mighty existence that strikes fear into the hearts of the entire continent.
